caption: The drawing depicts a metallic hanging object resembling a kettle or a container with a lid and a prominent arched handle connected at two points to the round body. At the top of the handle, a triangular loop is attached to a circular ring for hanging purposes. The object is rendered in shades of brown with highlights and shadows indicating a metallic material. On top of the lid, there is a small sculpted figure of a bird along with two small protruding cylindrical elements. The background includes several technical sketches in black lines: one shows the object hanging from a hook with the word "HANGING" vertically aligned, another shows it suspended from a rod with the caption "READY FOR USE INSIDE OVEN," and two smaller side views detail the bird-shaped knob and a base piece labeled "OIL." All the sketches are on a plain, off-white background, and there is also a scale notation "SCALE 1in=5" near the lower left side.
title: Amana Baker's Oven Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
